description.value: Cold Comfort Ice Cream is Victoria's original hand-made dairy ice cream shop, with the Rock Bay location serving as their production headquarters where all the ice cream is crafted from local and organic ingredients. They offer organic dairy custard alongside coconut milk-based 'Nicecream,' with a rotating roster of creative flavours available by the scoop. The shop also operates a mobile truck or bike for events and sells their ice cream sandwiches at over 20 local stockists around the city.
